mapper.select: SELECT R.RESUME_NO , R.USER_ID , R.USER_NAME , R.PHOTO , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(R.BIRTH, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH , R.EMAIL , R.TEL , R.ADDRESS , R.VETERAN_REASON , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(R.UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS UPDATE_DATE , R.RESUME_SUBMIT_YN , R.RESUME_DELETE_DATE , R.RESUME_MAIN_YN , R.INTRODUCTION_NO , R.RESUME_NAME , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MY_LICENSE WHERE RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO) AS MY_LICENSE_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CAREER WHERE RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO) AS CAREER_YN , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MILITARY WHERE RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO) AS MILITARY_YN , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LANGUAGE_SKILL WHERE RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO) AS LANGUAGE_SKILL_YN FROM RESUME R WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND RESUME_DELETE_DATE IS NULL AND RESUME_SUBMIT_YN = 'N'

SELECT RE.RESUME_NO , RE.RESUME_MAIN_YN , RE.INTRODUCTION_NO , RE.USER_ID , RE.USER_NAME , RE.PHOTO , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(RE.BIRTH, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH , RE.EMAIL , RE.TEL , RE.ADDRESS , RE.VETERAN_REASON , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(RE.UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS UPDATE_DATE , RE.RESUME_SUBMIT_YN , RE.RESUME_DELETE_DATE , RE.RESUME_NAME , INT.INTRODUCTION_NAME , INT.INTRODUCTION_CONTENT , INT.INTRODUCTION_QUESTION , TO_CHAR(INT.INTRODUCTION_CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INTRODUCTION_CREATE_DATE , TO_CHAR(INT.INTRODUCTION_DELETE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INTRODUCTION_DELETE_DATE , INT.INTRODUCTION_SUBMIT_YN FROM RESUME RE LEFT JOIN INTRODUCTION INT ON RE.INTRODUCTION_NO = INT.INTRODUCTION_NO WHERE RE.USER_ID = #{userId} AND RE.RESUME_DELETE_DATE IS NULL AND RE.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo}

SELECT r.RESUME_NO, r.USER_ID, r.USER_NAME, c.CAREER_NO, c.JOB_CODE, c.START_WORK_DATE, c.RETIRE_DATE, c.TENURE, c.DEPARTMENT, c.RESPONSIBILITY, c.FREELANCER, c.JOB_GRADE_CODE, c.POSITION_CODE, c.CAREER_YEAR, c.SALARY, c.LOCATION, c.COM_ID, comp.COM_NAME FROM RESUME r LEFT JOIN CAREER c ON r.RESUME_NO = c.RESUME_NO LEFT JOIN COMPANY comp ON c.COM_ID = comp.USER_ID WHERE r.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY r.UPDATE_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM RESUME WHERE RESUME_DELETE_DATE IS NULL AND RESUME_NAME LIKE '%'||#{resumeName}||'%' AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND RESUME_SUBMIT_YN = 'N'
